description: OxidANT's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ANTfrastructure's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the four top-level consumers.
The shared preset enables Renovate's git-submodules manager. The local driver also checks every direct gitlink against its remote default branch even when Renovate returns no submodule rows.
.gitmodules names `branch = develop` for the ANTfrastructure checkout, but the local driver follows the remote default branch regardless of that setting.
Dependabot is off family-wide (owner, 2026-10-20): .github/dependabot.yml is deleted, so this file is the only watch over cargo and the pinned GitHub Actions.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ANTfrastructure, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And the Renovate GitHub App is NOT installed on this repository and will not be (owner decision, 2026-09-09) -- no bot will ever author a commit here. That does not make this file idle: the local CLI reads exactly it. See third_party/ANTfrastructure/docs/dependency-updates.md.

third_party/egui-winit-0.36.2 is the published crate with one patched file (PATCHED.md), routed in through [patch.crates-io] until egui ships emilk/egui#8516 (BACKLOG.md). Its Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are upstream's, and no build reads that lock.

Watched, it put five rows in the 2026-10-07 report (log, serde, webbrowser, smithay-clipboard, objc2), whose apply half then refused the whole run, and its lock maintenance fails because cargo will not refresh a lock inside this workspace (`current package believes it's in a workspace when it's not`, 2026-10-13). Disabled here, Renovate and renovate-local.sh's planner (packageRules with matchFileNames) both skip it; the egui family stays watched through the root Cargo.toml.
third_party/tract-linalg-0.23.8 is the same kind of copy (one build.rs line, its PATCHED.md) and is skipped for the same reasons; the tract family stays watched through crates/inference/Cargo.toml.
third_party/burn-dispatch-0.22.1 is the published crate with its unused Torch backend disabled (PATCHED.md); the root Cargo.toml watches the Burn version while this temporary source copy is skipped.

packageRules.description: Burn and the vendored burn-dispatch patch must be upgraded together; PATCHED.md records the source checksum and the lock-graph proof.
